resources.string: Notify when the tunnel is not carrying in the background, the device needs approval, or quota is almost exhausted.
The tunnel has not connected in the background for a while. Open the app to check status.
The operator needs to approve or unblock this device.
Local HTTP/CONNECT proxy for Android Wi-Fi proxy settings. Disabled by default.
Settings → Wi-Fi → your network → Proxy → Manual → host 127.0.0.1, port 18090.
Disabled by default. If enabled, the app can download updates without the tunnel from operator HTTPS mirrors; the mirror will see your real IP and the connection will be visible to the network.
Disabled by default. If enabled, the app downloads and verifies the APK in the background; installation still requires user confirmation.
By default auto-download is allowed only on Wi-Fi/ethernet and does not run on mobile networks.
Enable only if the operator channel and data plan allow background APK downloads on cellular/metered networks.

Disabled by default. If enabled, the app first checks the operator-signed egress endpoint list through the tunnel; if the tunnel is unavailable, it may make a direct request to the operator server and expose your real IP. Unsigned or stale data is rejected.
Scan the QR from the orchestrator web admin, or import the one-time bootstrap as Base64/JSON. The app will verify expiry and the config key.
